turn: I added a Page dataclass in src/entities/model.py with id, title, parent_id, version and status fields, and the parser now maps each page element in entities.xml to one of these objects. I made parent_id optional so top-level pages with no parent come through as None instead of failing. To check it, I parsed the sample entities.xml and confirmed that the page count matched the number of page elements and that the fields on a few pages matched the XML. I also checked that a page without a parent gets None. While I was in there I noticed that the XML reader left a file handle open when parsing raised an error, so I changed it to close the file in every case, and that change is in the same commit. Next I'll start on "Build the page hierarchy".

sidefix.title: Close file handle on parse errors
sidefix.what: The XML reader left its file handle open when parsing raised an error, so it now closes the file in every case.
